# Assumption of Moses Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Final Persecution

---

**8:1** And they will punish and torment those who are righteous, and they will say: let us be like them.

**8:2** And at that time kings from the east will rise up against them and will come and seize them.

**8:3** And a powerful king will arise who will be a judge of the whole earth, and he will oppress them.

**8:4** And he will be a man of power and audacity, a judge who will punish those who turn away.

**8:5** He will crucify those who confess their ways and will put their cities to the sword.

**8:6** He will burn their cities with fire, and their holy things and sacred objects will be removed.

**8:7** He will burn their sanctuary with fire, and will cut off their entire heritage, cutting out the righteous from among them.

**8:8** They will be put to death, and they will be plundered and tortured.

**8:9** Because they were not faithful, they will receive punishment worthy of their wickedness.

**8:10** They will be punished by the sword, and they will be carried off into captivity.

**8:11** Part of them will be destroyed and made desolate.

**8:12** And he will come against them with great fury, and the houses of their holy ones will be torn down.

**8:13** In those days there will be a great tribulation such as there has never been in the world since the beginning.

**8:14** Even the patriarchs of old would not have been able to withstand such tribulation.

**8:15** Those who have been righteous will mourn for their brothers.
